recipe.visualDefinition: A central group portrait of four musicians framed within a rounded rectangular cutout, set against a vibrant psychedelic background featuring a large yellow sun, radiating sunburst rays, and undulating horizontal waves of color. The composition is anchored at the bottom by vintage-style floral illustrations and swallow birds.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait group framed by a geometric window
Radiating sunburst lines originating from behind the portrait
Horizontal wavy color bands intersecting the vertical sunburst
Symmetrical floral and avian accents at the bottom corners
coreInvariants: Large yellow circular sun behind the subjects
Wavy horizontal bands in muted teal, purple, and pink
Dark navy or black outer border framing the entire scene
Rounded rectangular frame for the central photographic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects in formal attire occupy the central 50% of the vertical space, framed within a rounded rectangle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow sun serves as the primary visual anchor, drawing the eye to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down the sunburst rays to the central portrait, and finally settles on the decorative floral elements at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep navy space at the top corners provides breathing room for the display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue serves as the background and framing color.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow sun provides high contrast against the dark background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted pink, teal, and lavender are used for the wavy bands and floral details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central sun and text, with lower-value, earthy tones in the wavy bands to create a vintage 1970s feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a 70s-inspired palette of ochre, teal, and mauve

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space above the sun
Overlapping the top of the sunburst

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy block display font paired with a lighter, more legible grotesque for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, blocky presence of the main title.
Matches the secondary text's clean, mid-century grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s soul-inspired background with a large yellow sun in the center, radiating sunburst rays in dark navy and purple. Add horizontal wavy bands in teal, lavender, and pink across the middle. Include a central rounded rectangular window. At the bottom, place vintage-style illustrations of red and yellow roses and blue swallow birds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy, stacked, pink geometric sans-serif font at the top center. Below it, add the secondary text in a smaller, white grotesque sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Are the wavy bands symmetrical across the horizontal axis?
Is the main title font sufficiently heavy and blocky?
Do the floral elements look like vintage botanical illustrations?

adjustableVariables: Type of flowers used in the collage
Thickness of the rounded rectangle frame
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Specific flower arrangements to avoid direct copy

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp geometric shapes in the background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background
Check that the sunburst rays align with the center of the sun
Verify the rounded rectangle frame is centered
Confirm the floral elements do not overlap the subjects' faces
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + Geometric frame + Sunburst/Wave background + Stacked block typography + Vintage botanical accents.
